name: mediator complex subunit 28

function.text: MED28 is the approved symbol for mediator complex subunit 28. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in positive regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II; positive regulation of transcription initiation by RNA polymerase II.

function.text: MED28 encodes mediator complex subunit 28. It forms part of the Mediator complex, a coactivator involved in the regulated transcription of nearly all RNA polymerase II-dependent genes. Mediator is recruited to promoters by direct interactions with regulatory proteins and serves as a scaffold for the assembly of a functional pre-initiation complex with RNA polymerase II and the general transcription factors. It may be part of a complex containing NF2/merlin that participates in cellular signaling to the actin cytoskeleton downstream of tyrosine kinase signaling pathways.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MED28 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
